# TrustPay

> USDC escrow on Arc (Circle's stablecoin L1, where gas is paid in USDC). A client locks USDC for a freelancer; the client releases it, or an AI agent checks the delivery against the written brief and settles it on-chain.

## How it works
- Create: the client sets the freelancer's wallet, an amount in USDC, a deadline and a brief, then locks the funds (`createDeal`).
- Deliver: the freelancer submits a link to the work (`submitWork`).
- Settle: the client releases payment (`release`), or either side raises a dispute and the AI agent splits the funds (`resolve`). After 24h without a client response the freelancer can also ask the agent.
- Safety nets: no delivery by the deadline means a full refund to the client (`refund`). The agent can only pay the client or the freelancer, never anyone else.

## Pages
- [Home](/): what TrustPay is and how it works
- [Your escrows](/app): deals where the connected wallet is client or freelancer
- [New escrow](/app/new): lock USDC for a freelancer
- [Wallet](/app/wallet): swap USDC/EURC on Arc and bridge USDC to Arc via Circle CCTP

## Tech
- Smart contract: Solidity, Foundry, OpenZeppelin (`TrustPayEscrow.sol`)
- Web: Next.js, wagmi/viem, Circle App Kit
- AI: open-source `openai/gpt-oss-120b` on Groq

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/anshxft/trustpay)
